title: HtmlPreview
description: Previews untrusted HTML such as email templates in a fully sandboxed iframe. The markup is sanitized with DOMPurify (fail-closed) and rendered behind a Content-Security-Policy that blocks scripts and network access.

wc:minerva-html-preview.summary: Sandboxed, sanitized preview of untrusted HTML.
wc:minerva-html-preview.description: Previews untrusted HTML (e.g. an email template) in a fully sandboxed iframe (`<HtmlPreview>` of React). The markup is sanitized with DOMPurify (fail-closed: an empty document when the sanitizer's self-check does not pass) and rendered behind a Content-Security-Policy that blocks scripts and network access; only inline styles and `data:` images are allowed. The iframe itself is not configurable: always `sandbox=""`, no referrer. Sanitizing needs a browser DOM: during SSR the empty shell is rendered and the document is filled on the client.

properties.name: html
properties.description: Untrusted HTML to preview (sanitized in the browser)

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible title of the iframe (the React library's `title`; falls back to aria-label)

properties.name: viewport
properties.description: Full-width desktop preview or fixed-width mobile preview

properties.name: mobileWidth
properties.description: Width of the mobile preview in pixels (invalid values fall back to 375)

properties.name: height
properties.description: Height of the iframe in pixels (invalid values fall back to 600)
